codeReview.summary: The feature adds the requested shared component set, but there are blocking behavior gaps in keyboard shortcuts and mobile inspector behavior, plus an unsafe JSON rendering path.

issues.description: Mobile inspector drawer is effectively unreachable. The only inspector expand control is gated by `!isMobile` (desktop-only), and `showMobileInspector` is never set to `true` anywhere (only initialized/closed), so narrow-screen drawer mode cannot be opened as required by VAL-REACT-FND-004.

Shortcut parsing treats `g+c` as a single-key match on `g` (first non-modifier token), so pressing `g` alone triggers navigation. This does not implement the required `g then c` behavior in VAL-REACT-FND-006 and will hijack normal typing of `g`.

`dangerouslySetInnerHTML` is fed from `JSON.stringify` output after regex replacement without HTML escaping, which can render untrusted string content as markup. This is an avoidable XSS risk in a shared viewer component.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The frontend-worker skill and mission AGENTS guidance conflict on Playwright expectations: skill mandates running full `npx playwright test`, while mission guidance says full suite is currently expected to fail and scoped specs should be used. This mismatch can lead to inconsistent worker behavior.

summary: Reviewed transcript skeleton, handoff, skill, and commit 65ec057e962541c6a21b77d9e0871fccfaf86ad2. Result is FAIL due to blocking gaps in mobile inspector drawer accessibility and incorrect `g+c` shortcut semantics; also noted non-blocking JSON rendering safety risk and a skill-guidance mismatch in shared state.
